_note: Curated OPEN items from ../teryx-shop-log.md (newest at the bottom; superseded entries dropped) and repo docs. BACKLOG.md items are parsed automatically by tools/build_checklist.py; 'dup' = regex of BACKLOG text this item replaces (dedupe).

items.t: Install the e-stop: XB4/XB5 40 mm twist-release (XB4BS8442 head has 1 NC) + 2 extra ZBE102, direct (no relay): block 1 both EV200 coils (OK, 0.26 A break), block 2 precharge coil + Kelly KSI, block 3 Teensy B latch input; IP65 guarded box
Nothing flashed until the BICM temperature formula and the BICM ID mapping are verified on the bench
DC-DC TDC-JH isolation test (power off: pack ± to 12 V− open / ≥1 MΩ) before bonding 12 V− to the chassis
Chain guard + chain tensioner / chain line with the motor up front (#50, 16/32T)

items.src: shop log Drivetrain tasks · BACKLOG Mechanical
items.t: Pack mounts / cage / tie-downs, HV cable clamps, grommets at every pass-through
Confirm the custom axle pinions are still OEM 8T/35T (4.375)
Custom axle: shaft, bearings, how it meets the F/R diffs
Tape / scan the under-seat and tunnel cavities (seats down)
Place the 36S strings under the seats (power off before any harness change)
Motor temp sensor into the Kelly (Temp pin 1, KTY84/83 per manual)
Kelly cooling loop: reservoir/fill → pump → Kelly W3-GT2 → stock radiator → back, no thermostat; measure hose sizes
Free + lube the 4WD and diff-lock cables; measure cable pull force (scale) and travel
Mount the 2 BTS7960 H-bridges inside the sealed enclosure
Dash tablet mount + vibration isolators, soft-mount, strain-relieve the charge cable
Enclosure sealing with a breather and a drain
Chassis ground straps: 12 V− to frame, Kelly case to frame
Read the seat heater type (single/two-stage)
2× M4 18S BICM (VTSM#4, used Gen1 pulls, ~$50-70 ea)
2× SN65HVD230 transceivers (need 6, own 4)
Throttle clamp parts: CD74HCT123E, CD74HC4066E, SN74AHCT125N, MCP4131-103E/P + 100k/10k/1 µF/100 nF
E-stop: Schneider XB4 metal (or IDEC) mushroom, 2 NC blocks, guard ring, IP65 box + bracket, Deutsch connector
REQUIRED BEFORE FIRST DRIVE — dual-output Hall throttle pedal (2 independent tracks, A reads track 1, B reads track 2). Part TBD
3-pole parking-brake switch (2 NO + 1 NC) + 12 V SPDT relay for the Kelly ECO Low cap + FET + 1N4007
2× Glideforce LACT4P-12V-10 actuators (-20 if cable > 30 lb) + 2× BTS7960 H-bridge modules
Cooling: Bosch 0392022010 12 V pump (~$162), hose reducers, hose + clamps, 50/50 coolant, fan relay + fuse
HV build: 1/0 + 3/0 tinned lugs + hydraulic crimper, copper bus bar + insulated standoffs + clear cover, 1/0 string leads, HV orange loom + clamps/grommets
Branch fuses: charger 60-70 A ≥250 VDC, DC-DC 15-20 A; any holder at pack voltage rated > 160 VDC (string A6T200s need no holders)

12 V side: key switch, 12 V battery, fused distribution block, 16-20 AWG TXL, Deutsch DT pins/seals + crimper, 3 inline mini-blade holders, 3 TVS, IRLB3813 FETs (IRLB8721 discontinued), panel-mount USB extension
NACS AC inlet (into the Elcon)
Insulation tester (or borrow) + isolation monitor (part not chosen)
Dash: Android tablet 10-11" ≥8 GB, rugged case, fused 12 V → USB-C PD ~45 W, phone cradle, ESP32 enclosure + buck + fuse
Recheck the pedal curve with the 100k Kelly-side pull-down fitted (0/25/50/75/100 % × wiper, ±2 %)
Scope the 74HCT123 one-shot pulse width (target 3-8 ms) and check the 4066 leakage at 5 V
Park interlock: brake set + throttle = 0 RPM (Kelly Foot Switch checked); photo of the parking-brake lever for switch fit
Kelly ECO Low cap: relay off → full pedal stays ≤ cap RPM; confirm ECO pin on the harness
Kelly CAN candump matches 0x0CF11E05 / 0x0CF11F05 layout before BMS_CAP_KELLY_RX=1
BICM temps vs a thermometer on the bricks (then TEMPS_VERIFIED=1)
Elcon stop/timeout test on a real string at ~1 A, V set a few volts under string total (clamp meter)
Meter transceiver/DROK pin order and the Kelly input polarity before soldering the perfboards
Clamp-meter the radiator fan inrush; meter the actuator pots
Silent-string fault 2000 ms vs the bench 'd' max gap on first run
1 kHz ISR: maxPeriodUs < 2000 on the Teensy
MCP23017 expander (BODY_IO_EXPANDER=1, frees pin 32 for park A) vs jumpers
Precharge requires the parking brake (PROPOSED on)
Low cap numbers: 1 s ramp, 30 % end, 10 mph; LEM disagreement 60 A / 50 %
Zero 75-7R ratings (kW, torque, max RPM, voltage) for the motor model
Push + flash OK (in the 1:1) once the bench gates pass
